Subject: Azure Marketplace SaaS offer - publisher account setup & technical validation checklist

Hi Alina / Contoso team,

Thanks again for the help getting Redwood's SaaS offer into the Azure Marketplace. We're ready to start publisher onboarding and want to make sure the technical validation step is scoped correctly so we don't miss anything in the handoff.

Attached is our initial publish package (redwood_publish_package_v1.zip) with the ARM templates, offer manifest, and a short integration README. Also attached: security-evidence-summary.pdf and a one-time test account (saaS-test-credentials.txt).

High-level ask: can you confirm the exact artifacts and test scenarios the Azure validation team will run for a SaaS-API offer? Specifically:
- Required portal metadata fields and any known gotchas for co-sell opt-in
- End-to-end functional checks (tenant onboarding, trial provisioning flow, single-tenant vs multi-tenant behaviors)
- Integration points for billing and meter events (if applicable)
- Minimum security artifacts accepted (SOC2, ASV scan, data deletion SLA)
- Whether a short sandbox call with a test user is necessary and preferred time windows

If possible, please include a checklist we can map to owners internally. We're aiming for a validation window next week (Jan 12-14).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi Grace — great to hear you're ready. Thanks for the package, I reviewed the manifest briefly and it looks mostly complete. Below is the validation checklist our team will use; please map owners and attach any missing evidence.

Azure validation checklist (SaaS/API offer)
1) Publisher account & offer basics
   - Publisher account verified in Partner Center (we need the publisher ID)
   - Offer visibility: pricing plans configured (trial plan present if you offer trials)
2) Functional validation
   - Provisioning: create trial tenant via portal, verify provisioning webhook fires and DB record created
   - Login: sign-in flow for provisioning/admin portal; verify role assignment for tenant admin
   - API calls: sample end-to-end API call to create resource, expect 200/201 and correct payloads
3) Billing & meter-checks (if comsumption billing used)
   - Meter events appear in the test billing feed (sample usage file acceptable)
   - Pricing visible and maps to plan IDs in manifest
4) Security & compliance evidence
   - SOC 2 Type II report OR evidence summary with compensating controls
   - Data retention and deletion policy (doc or link)
   - TLS certs for endpoints and ASV scan if applicable
5) Co-sell opt-in & marketplace metadata
   - Verify co-sell metadata populated (resale/cpa fields), publish lead routing settings
   - Co-sell registration form link validated
6) Docs & support links
   - Public/private docs links in offer description, support contact configured
7) Test accounts and support during validation
   - Please provide a test tenant with admin rights and a short runbook for us to use during validation

Preferred schedule: We can allocate validation on Tue/Wed (Jan 13-14) afternoon PST. To proceed we'd need:
- Partner Center publisher ID (or a screenshot of the Publisher page)
- A test tenant with admin creds (we can use the one you attached)
- SOC2 summary or equivalent evidence by EOD Mon (Jan 12)

If you want, we can do a 30-minute pre-validation call tomorrow (Jan 13 16:00 PST) to walk through the test flows. Let me know which of the above items you can deliver and I'll open the validation ticket.

Regards,
Alina
Program Manager, Azure Marketplace
Alina.Kos@microsoft.com
